title: 拉克丝·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 蓝白衣装带金色饰边，金发与蓝色双眼呼应双端法杖。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Lux is an adult blonde light mage with bright blue eyes, a composed open face, and blue-white clothing with gold trim. Preserve her slender natural adult proportions and short cape while using a fully covering high-neck long-sleeved tunic, opaque tights or trousers, gloves, and boots. Her recognizable double-ended light staff rests vertically on the floor, inactive except for a restrained steady highlight.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sky blue, ivory, pale gold, cobalt shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
